nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Oh! Hi. Sorry, I've been staring at this circuit since sunrise. I'm Stella.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: You're new here too, aren't you? What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: {player}. Nice to meet you. Please don't touch the bench, it's mid-experiment. Wouldn't want your first day to be that memorable.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Wait, you're the new arrival for our dormitory? Then we're dormmates. Quiet hours start at ten, and my plushies are not decorations. I'll write the rest of the rules down for you.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Oh! Hi! You startled me. I'm Cinna. Cinna Cirra, if you want the whole thing.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: And you are...? Sorry, I'm meant to ask that first. I read a book about it.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: {player}. Got it. I'm writing it down so I don't forget.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Oh! You're the new student in our dormitory? Then we're dormmates! I've never had a dormmate before. I hope I'm good at it.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Oh, hey. Didn't hear you over the gears. I'm Orio.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Name? I'm optimising introductions. Shortest version wins.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: {player}. Nice. Saved to memory. No backup, though.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Hang on, you're the new one in our dorm? Nice, dormmates. If you hear flip-flops in the hall at 3 a.m., that's just me getting back.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: You've got the look of someone about to ask a question. I'm Katrina.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: And you are? Quickly. I've got a lot to do today.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: {player}. Noted. I'll try to remember it. That's a sore subject at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Hold on. You're the new arrival in our dormitory? Then we're dormmates. Ground rule: the hall mirror is mine before nine.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Oh, hello! Don't mind the scorch marks, that was me. I'm Grace.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: I haven't seen you on the trail before. What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, {player}. Welcome to the quietest classroom on campus.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Ah. A new face among the shelves. I am Professor Voltaire, and this Library is my responsibility.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Whom do I have the pleasure of adding to my records?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: {player}. Splendid. I never forget a name, particularly on an overdue notice.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Shh. ...Hm? Oh. I'm Vex.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: And you are? Whisper it.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: {player}. Fine. Welcome. Quietly.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Hello! I'm Luna. You're new, aren't you? You've got that looking-around face.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: {player}. That sounds like it belongs on a star chart.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Hi! I'm Juno. I know everyone on campus, which means I definitely don't know you.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: So who are you? Quick, before the rumours start without me.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: {player}! Great. Now I know everyone again.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Hey! New arrival? Me too. I'm Rowan.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: What's your name? I'm collecting fellow people without a room.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, {player}. Welcome to the lobby. I live here now, apparently.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: ...Oh. Hello. I'm Moss.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: You walk softly. That's good. What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: {player}. Nice to meet you. Quietly.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Hello, and welcome! I'm Marigold, one of the dormitory receptionists.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: And who might you be?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: {player}. Lovely to meet you. Make yourself at home in the lobby.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Oh! Hello. Sorry, I didn't see you there. I'm Thistle.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: You are...? Hang on, let me find a pen. ...Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: {player}. Right. I'll remember that. Probably.
